Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def load():

    return G

    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])

    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    seprR=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(di[r]))==1 and di[r][0]!=bg]

    def make_bands(seps,n):
        b=[];prev=-1
        for s in sorted(set(seps)|{n}):
            if prev+1<s: b.append((prev+1,s-1))
            prev=s+1
        return b
    Rb=make_bands(seprR,H); Cb=make_bands(seprC,W)
    acc=set(sum(di,[]))-{bg}-{set(int(di[s][0]) for s in seprR)|set(int(di[0][s]) for s in seprC)}
    assert len(acc)==1, acc
    dot=acc.pop()

    for i,(r0,r1) in enumerate(Rb):

            cells=[(r,c,di[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
            outs=[(r,c,e[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]

            dbs=(min(drs),max(drs),min(dcs),max(dcs))
            info.append((i,j,len(cells),nd,nout,chg,'FULL' if filled else ('BGMIX' if not(chg and nout==len(cells)) else '?'),dbs))
    return info,bg,dot
